title: The Fed Didn't Hike. Why Are Borrowers Bracing?

scenes.vo: The Fed held rates in October. So why are borrowers bracing?

captions.text: The Fed held rates in October.

scenes.vo: Check the minutes, the meeting notes released three weeks later. The key is the wording.

captions.text: the meeting notes released three weeks later.

scenes.vo: Most officials backed holding at three seventy-five to four percent. Some wanted a hike. Almost all saw hikes likely.

captions.text: Most officials backed holding at 3.75% to 4%.

scenes.vo: Mortgage rates rose too: Freddie Mac's average hit seven twenty-eight, then eased to seven twenty-one.
Borrowing soon? Price your payment at a higher rate first.

captions.text: Price your payment at a higher rate first.

minutesRelease.unit: release date of minutes for the Oct 27-28, 2026 FOMC meeting (3 weeks after the decision)

fedRange.unit: % federal funds target range, held; vote 10-2 (Cook, Hammack preferred +25 bp)

minutesWording.unit: quoted quantifiers: 'most participants expressed support for maintaining the target range'; 'Some participants favored an increase of 25 basis points'; 'almost all participants judged that, under their baseline outlooks...' further increases 'would likely be appropriate'. No official numeric definitions, so no counts are shown.

pmmsYearAgo.unit: % 30-yr fixed average a year earlier (as cited in the Nov 25, 2026 release)
pmmsYearAgo.source: Freddie Mac PMMS release 'Mortgage Rates Dip to 7.21%', Nov 25, 2026

pmmsNov13.source: Freddie Mac PMMS, Nov 19, 2026 release (prior-week value)

pmmsNov25.source: Freddie Mac PMMS release 'Mortgage Rates Dip to 7.21%', Nov 25, 2026 12:00 ET (GlobeNewswire)

illustrativePayment.unit: $ monthly P&I, Illustrative: $300,000, 30-yr fixed, 7.11% vs 7.28% (computed in scenes/math.ts); excludes taxes and insurance

notes: Mortgage rates are shown alongside the minutes, not as caused by them.
'Almost all saw hikes likely' is a projection conditional on officials' baseline outlooks, not a decision.

Refreshed 2026-11-25: Freddie Mac PMMS Nov 25 = 7.21% (down from 7.28%). S4 VO changed from '...hit seven twenty-eight, up from seven eleven.' to '...hit seven twenty-eight, then eased to seven twenty-one.' (69 -> 70 words).
